title: MAKING THE GREAT RED DRAGON'S 8TH HEAD "GREAT AGAIN"

sense.text:
“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” If Esau is not the wicked, then you tell God where and who the wicked is. The wicked have the earth in their hand, and they cover the faces of the judges.

That is what making the great red dragon’s eighth head great again is about. The beast called America is that eighth head that rode on the back of the seven heads that carried her, and the runners of America, presidents, governors and everyone set up to sustain it, are duty bound in their spirit to make it last forever, at our detriment. This place would not be anything if it were not for slavery. The fuel that built this eighth head, and the whole world economy, is our destruction: Israel pillaged, exploited, robbed, raped, hung. The nations rose to their prominence because they had the talents, the resources and the very minds of the nation of Israel under their control, while they kept us at a deficit so we would never recognize our true potential.

Kill the Indian and save the man: kill his real spirit but save the body, save the sweat equity. To get the sweat equity out of a people you kill the strong man, which is their mind and their culture, the things that made us a people in the first place. That is what has been done to the twelve tribes of Israel. We are a shell of a people, in the ghettos and in the streets, the dry bones in the valley, lost, with no sense of unity. As long as we are disunified and at odds with each other, that is the fuel that keeps this system going.

Trump is only out pronouncing it. This has always been the objective of this country and of the planet earth: they want to keep it this way.

The eighth head has the attributes of all the rest of the seven, and it set itself up as the imperial of them all. They all honor and worship this beast America, mainly because it has the greatest concentration of its labor, meaning us. That is what made it great, and for it to remain great they have to keep the process of slavery going by another name. It was great when we were in chattel slavery, when the negro had no mouth to say anything. Those are the good old days they want back, and the good old days for them are the bad old days for us.

Even so, in defiance of that virulent hatred we built Black Wall Street, Durham, Rosewood and towns all over this country. Then came Jim Crow, the black codes and convict leasing: you could go outside and get lynched, and there was no agency to go to, because the police, the government and the doctors were all on his side. Charles Drew, who invented the blood bank, was refused blood in his own invention’s hospital. That is the kind of tyranny we lived under. The wicked have the systems, and J. Edgar Hoover said the single greatest threat to the United States of America was negro unity.

So the elders of the civil rights times strategized to get inside the system, to get some of us into the police, the hospitals and the agencies so there would be some oversight of what they do to us. The Bible is not about integration, but understand the turbulent times they were living in before you talk smack about what those men were doing. Now they are gerrymandering and changing the voting districts to get blacks out of those seats, so that with no one overseeing their wicked actions they can run with free reign: might is right. That is why Rasheem Carter and Kendrick Johnson can get no justice.

precepts.why:
While people wrestle with it in their mind, saying that is not talking about him, hit them with this: “When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice”. The righteous are the Israelites. When the righteous are in authority, the people of the earth rejoice, and it is obvious the righteous are not winning. The righteous are not in rulership at all.

“But when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.” Everybody is mourning. The birds are mourning, the sharks are mourning; everything on the planet earth is catching hell because there is a fool in office, a fool ruling. That is the wicked that the earth is given into the hand of.

King Solomon said, “There is an evil which I have seen under the sun”. The Most High showed him visions of where this planet is going. “As an error which proceedeth from the ruler”: an error that proceeds from the people running this planet, meaning the wrong people are ruling. The wrong type of rulership is on this planet now.

“Folly is set in great dignity”: a fool is set as a judge, a fool sitting up like they have some sense. They pollute the only air you can breathe and the only water you can drink. It is a complete mess. The people’s minds are all polluted: a man doesn’t even know if he’s a man, a woman doesn’t even know if she’s a woman.

“And the rich sit in low place.” We are the rich, and we sit in low place, sitting like we are the bums. We are the princes of God. That is what Israel means: the prince of the Most High. Yet we are sitting like servants.

“I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.” The man in the power seat is a servant to you, and the Most High has it recorded. The statue that stood in front of the Museum of Natural History on 81st Street shows it: Teddy Roosevelt on the horse, sitting in the power seat like he is in rulership, and the servants on the side. Gad is on his right side and Judah on his left.

Look at Judah: the butt of the musket on his hip and the sight on the barrel up. The negro is so brainwashed he will fight for the man on the horse. Judah is asleep. Now look at Gad: he has the gun pointed down in defiance, like, you are on my land, I am not fighting for you. For that to even be put up, the sculptor had to know the psychology of the negro and the psychology of Gad. A lot of thinking went into it, and now they have taken it down.

The princes walking as servants upon the earth are the Israelites, the twelve tribes of Israel.

We are still dealing with a fool in a dignified seat. “They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness”. All of the people walk on in darkness because the wicked is ruling and the Israelites are not. It was written by the musician Asaph, but it is still dealing with the Israelites. The people walk on in gross darkness; like it says in Isaiah, our people are completely blind and stripped of any semblance of sanity.

“All the foundations of the earth are out of course.” Out of sync, out of proper alignment. It is like driving a car with the wheels all messed up: that car is not going to go straight, and that is how the earth is, because it has a fool as the driver.

The foundations are the very basics of everything that we do. The basics of people’s understanding are off, the basics of education are off; the foundation of everything is corrupt. That is what we are dealing with.

sense.text:
J. Edgar Hoover said the single greatest threat to the United States of America was negro unity. The bond of white supremacy has to continue, even if they change the names of the few that run it. Supremacy means supreme, all power, and the opposite of that is inferior. Black unity, the Israelite unity: once we come together, we identify that we are not inferior to them.

“Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.” What did we hear and understand? That the Most High brings the deep things to light, and that the nations he enlarges he will straiten again.

“What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.” We are not inferior to them. What they know, we know: we know that we are the Israelites, and we know that we are not inferior to them.

“Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.” We are going to God, not to white Jesus; that is foolishness. We go to the Messiah, the black Messiah, reasoning with God to deliver us and to straighten them.

“But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.” That is why our people are dying in the streets to them, going on boat trips with them and having sleepovers with them: we have not as a people come to the acknowledgement that we are not inferior to them. We are not trying to fit into their world. We know that they are liars and forgers, and there is no value in joining unto them. We join back to God through Christ. They are beneath us.

That is the statue of Roosevelt on the horse again. The sight on Judah’s musket says: I got you trained. You are going to pull it for me, but not on me. Why? Because at one time we thought we were inferior to them. Now we are coming full circle. And Gad might shoot him. Gad says, what are you doing with a United Nations building on my land, talking about injustices, when the territory the building sits on belongs to me and I don’t have a seat anywhere in it? I am not fighting for you. And so they said, we will just wipe you out then.

precepts.why:
“He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.” We bring things to light. This Bible is dark to the Christian church; they don’t understand it when we speak about vengeance.

“He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them”: we understand that they are going to fall. This eighth head will fall. “He enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again”: we understand that they are going to grow in power, but there is a phenomenon on the earth, and that is us. We are the phenomenon that is going to disrupt this whole thing.

That is what our eye has seen and our ear has heard and understood.

sense.text:
America seeks to corrupt our young children while they are still mentally developing, so that by the time they mature they have already ruined their lives beyond repair. The prefrontal cortex takes time to develop, and the drill music feeds into it. A child who is not daunted with fear, who pushes past the inhibitions his parents and the community gave him, is influenced to act as a sociopath, with no empathy, no regard for social norms, mainly the Bible, and a tunnel vision to do the crime anyway. The Lord gave you that fear for a reason. Without it, the next thing you know you are doing life in prison before you are twenty, and the state loves that, because that is the sweat equity they want out of him.

Our children are labeled baddies and the like, not registering any emotions, with a tunnel vision singleness of mind to achieve the goal, and they become like little monsters in the neighborhood. Hillary Clinton called them super predators; Joe Biden said we can’t be rehabilitating them, lock them up and throw away the key. All of it is by design: they give you the music, you get influenced by it, then they call you a monster. It is a setup. The criminal behavior is driven by alcohol and drugs, by social media postings, by drill rap music, by the movies, while the children’s minds are still undeveloped.

“There shall be a confusion also in many places, and the fire shall be oft sent out again”: that is the last days, the times we are in now. “And the wild beasts shall change their places”: animal habitats are scattered all over the place. Like we read, all the foundations of the earth are out of course; everything is upside down.

“And menstruous women shall bring forth monsters”. Menstruous women means demonic, evil, I ain’t got no man, you can’t tell me nothing type of woman, with a mouth as wide as Madison Avenue. And she brings forth demons. That is what you have out here now: wild drill music, demons with no empathy who don’t care about nothing, shooting up the block, putting the illegal switch on a Glock to make it shoot like a machine gun.

Then the enticement subsides and the reality seeps back in, and that sobering moment usually comes when the arrest is about to happen. The young men who killed Julio Foolio over a drill rap battle, all of them about twenty years old, tracked him down at his birthday party at a hotel with rifles fitted with brass catchers, thinking they were smart. The investigators put it together piece by piece from phone records, house cameras, license plate readers and cell towers. Every last one of them got life without parole, and the girl who drove got fifteen years. They were tried as adults, and the moment the gavel dropped their name disappeared: they became a number, property of the state, until they leave the prison in a body bag. That is the continuance of 400 years of sweat equity: influencing the next generation away from our protection and turning them out.

Parents, you don’t know what you are trying to save your children from, and they don’t either, until it is too late.

precepts.why:
“As for my people, children are their oppressors”. These same kids become the neighborhood oppressors, running around with Glocks and mags, tape on the mag, all that foolishness.

“And women rule over them.” There is no man anywhere in this picture: no man with authority, no dignity, no order, no structure. The single woman ran the man out, or she is too wild for him to deal with, and now she has these monsters as children. The women rule over the men, and the men have no power at all. She comes home, takes the head wrap off, and she is the cat; the man is the mouse in the house, and he has to run into the hole in the baseboard when the wife comes home. Some brothers are living like that.

“O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.” The man’s path is destroyed because the woman is running things, and she has no hedge and no cover. She is all out wild. The only covering over her head is the white man; she respects him. That is complete hell.

That is the menstruous woman bringing forth monsters.

sense.text:
The agents of socialization are the individuals, groups and institutions that shape a child’s self-identity and teach them what is normal. Their academics know it: the primary agent is the family, and the secondary agents are education and mass media. By design, the role of the parents has been handed off to the secondary agents, so what raises our kids now is mass media and short form video. It is part of the crafty counsel, the whole architecture they have put in place to break us down, because they understand that if we are for God, God is going to be for us.

“Give him no liberty in his youth, and wink not at his follies.” You have to hold those children in and take them by the reins. You are the one who is going to form their thoughts, their shape, their identity. What the Bishop brought out is not normal behavior, not for our people, the royalty, and not period: going wild over the lyrics in a song.

The eighth head knows this, and they don’t care if it affects some of theirs; that is collateral damage. Their elite give their own the lessons they need not to fall into it. We are the only ones eating this stuff up.

Train up a child while he is young, because the older they get and the more exposure they have to other agents of socialization, the less successful you will be. In the early years it falls mostly on the mother; then the man comes in with more influence, though his influence is always there as the head and covering of the home. Many of our people mistake feeding their kids, clothing them, keeping a roof over them and sending them to school for raising them. Those are two different things. There is a molding process that has to happen, and we are letting the polluted world raise these kids. Children are like arrows in your quiver, to deal with the enemies in the gate: you are leaving an avenger, a weapon, behind you.

There are layers to the revolution. Before the action you teach, you show, you paint the vision and get buy-in. It is revolutionary to revolt against the powers that be and their white supremacist ideology by applying these things in earnest at home. Sisters who ask how they can get involved: one of the strongest things you can do is play your role as a mother the way the scripture says, support your husband, and reflect it in your children. Even amongst the body there are monsters in some of these children.

One thing destroying these young people’s minds is the YouTube shorts. They fry the mind and train it for a quick fix, cutting down the attention span and the inhibitory control, the ability to stop impulses, which is managed by the prefrontal cortex. Lose that and you become a rapist, a thief, a murderer. A child who struggles in school that way ends up in a life of crime or saying welcome to Walmart: sweat equity. Esau is playing on a high level, and we are not inferior to them, but if we want our next generation to be better we have to train them, keep them off those things, and let them learn to read a book in its entirety.

And it is not just taking them off of it. Fill the void with something else, because when there is a void something is going to come in to fill it, either good and of God or evil and of the world and our oppressors. You are the determinant of that.

We cannot use the excuse that we are too busy to deal with these children. If all of us said that, we would be the last generation, and we would lose the whole nation. Do whatever you have to do to make sure this dragon doesn’t get to them, because they are trying to destroy them.

We are a brilliant people, the greatest in the world, gifted with natural intelligence and resources, and our enemies seek to subdue the stronghold that safeguards our gifts, which is the Bible, the laws of God. Like Delilah was sent by the Philistines to learn where Samson’s strength lay, they want to find out where our strength is: bind the strong man, then spoil his goods. Once they find it, their objective is to control our minds. That is where social media and the shorts come in. King Leopold told his missionaries to teach them to read but not to reason.

America is an engine built to run off one particular fuel. They can change the name, but the fuel that made the engine run is the fuel it takes to keep it running, and that fuel is slavery. The 13th Amendment says neither slavery nor involuntary servitude, except as a punishment for crime. So if they shape the society to make you criminals, if they miseducate your children so they cannot compete and resort to a life of crime, they still have slavery. Who builds a hotel and doesn’t expect guests? Their avarice, their greed, is an insatiable appetite for our talents and our intelligence. They want us around, but they don’t want us to do anything for ourselves.

“I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me”, because the Lord was showing Daniel visions of the end time, just like he did with the apostle John in Revelation.

“I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this.” Just like John, who wanted to know the mystery of the eighth head that rode on the back of the seven heads and came from the seventh, Daniel wanted to know the interpretation of the beast he was seeing. Daniel is saying the same thing.

“These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.” That is what John was shown when he was told of that eighth head, which was of the seven, riding upon a scarlet coloured beast: red. The great red dragon.

“But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom”. That is what they are trying to prevent. The saints of God, in this fourth kingdom, shall take the kingdom. That means America is not going to be great at all; it means America is going to be destroyed and subdued, and the Israelites are woken up and ready to receive their kingdom. That is why Hoover said they cannot allow us even a semblance of unity, and why they kill our leaders and anybody who seeks to unite us, especially when it comes to this Bible.

“And possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.” We are never going to lose. We are going to win and own the planet earth, and put the earth back in its proper form. All this foolishness and craziness is going to be done away with.

“Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass”. That is what America did: whipped all the nations and put them in subjection under her. It is what Revelation says about her committing fornication with the other nations and making them get in bed with her. If you don’t dance to her tune, she sets embargoes against you.

“And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell”. The three that fell are the Spanish-American war, the French-American war and the war of independence: the three kings America subdued to land this 250th year celebration, when they broke away from Great Britain.

“Even of that horn that had eyes”: that horn is America. Why did America have eyes? Because it has got you in it. The concentration of greatness, the inventions and great things done over this planet, is right here because we are in slavery yielding all of our talents, our greatness and our gifts to this beast.

“And a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows.” America is more stout than all the rest of the nations because she has the weapons; she has everything, and nobody else can deal with this beast.
“I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them”. That is the time period we are in now. They made war against us in slavery.

“Until the Ancient of days came”. We were going to be in their hands for the time, times and dividing of times: the three and a half, the 42 months, the 1260 days. All of it represents the time we are underneath this beast, waiting for our Lord to take us out of captivity.

“And judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.” That is what is coming, and that is what they are trying to prevent. They don’t want us to possess the whole planet earth and set it back up in righteousness. So there is a concerted effort to destroy the next generation. Just like Pharaoh looked to kill off the saviours and they looked to kill Christ, they are looking to kill our sons and daughters. Social media zapping the intelligence and attention span of your children is not fun and games; that is straight up war. The enemy has got inside their head and turned it around, and you can’t even sit down and have a conversation with the children you gave birth to.

“The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth”. The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: America has its military bases all over the planet. This is what Trump wants to keep going. Trump is not the head figure, a little Damien with 666 on the back of his head; he is part of the whole dynamic that runs this thing, just more pronounced with it. The whole system is that way, and we have been catching it.

“And shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.” They tread it down and put their philosophies on everybody on the planet earth. If you don’t dance to America’s tune, they put embargoes and sanctions against you so you can’t buy or sell. That is the beast we are dealing with, the same one looking to eat our children alive, and we are playing games.

“And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” The Israelites are given into the hands of this beast. A time is one, times is two more, and the dividing of time is a half: three and a half. Another part of the scriptures says 42 months, another 1260, and Revelation says three days and a half. It gives the same time everywhere, and it is the same historical account of where we are today.

That is the beast we are dealing with. The whole system wants its model to be setting America back to how they had it from the beginning, in slavery. They want that sweat equity.

Josephus records that when Alexander, whom they call the great, came and saw the priests in white garments and the high priest with the name of God engraved on his mitre, he adored that name, and when the book of Daniel was showed him, where Daniel declared that one of the Greeks should destroy the empire of the Persians, he supposed that he was the one intended. The priests showed Alexander he was in the Bible, and he ran with it.

“And it happened, after that Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian” had smitten “Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”. He perceived that it was him.

“And made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth, And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations”. That is America today. There is no difference, because they came back as the Romans and as America.

“Insomuch that the earth was quiet before him”: the earth was afraid. Whenever they stepped on the scene everybody moved out of the way, because this beast was terrible. This is the rough goat that came and smote the ram, Persia, that Daniel saw.
He “ruled over countries, and nations, and kings, who became tributaries unto him.” Tributaries became servants under him; they paid tribute, they paid taxes.

“And his servants bare rule every one in his place.” They all teach each other. They pass the information down from the Greeks to the Romans, the Spanish, the French, the Germans, the Russians and the British. All those records come down to the end on how to keep Israel subdued.

“And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.” They rule by evil. The earth is given into the hand of the wicked, and it is in the Bible. These people move with the fuel of envy and slavery, evil and slavery, and they have to keep that going.

“Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.” Why put all those scriptures together? Because if you do half of these things, you are not putting on the whole armour of God; you are putting on pieces.

It begins at home. Husbands in order, wives in order; if they are not in order, you can’t expect the children to be in order. If you are not redeeming the time because the days are evil, you are not going to teach your children to fear God.

If we want to strengthen our families, the husbands must be in order and the wives in order, and the children will learn how to obey the Lord by your behavior. In turn, they are putting on the whole armour of God.

precepts.why: “Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.” That is one piece of the whole armour, and the children learn it by the order they see at home.

“And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.” If the parents are not in order and not redeeming the time, they will not teach their children to fear God. That is why it says bring them up in the admonition of the Lord.

“Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church”. Wives submit to the husbands, husbands love their wives. The husband and the wife in order is part of the whole armour; without it the children will not be in order.

“See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise, Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.” Walk circumspectly and redeem the time, because the days are evil. If you are not redeeming the time, you are not going to teach your children how to fear God.

“And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children”: teach them the laws of God, diligently. “And shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down”.

Teach them in the house, and when they wake up, and when they lie down. That is a routine of the word, repetition.

“Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord”. Over and over: you sing these songs, you read these words. It is repetition, to mold their minds concerning the laws of God.
Why do we have to do that? “Then beware lest thou forget the Lord, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt”. That is why you do it. If you forget the Lord, you are going to be tempted.

“Ye shall not tempt the Lord your God”. How do you not tempt him? Teach them diligently, the husband in order, the wife in order, redeeming the time because the days are evil.

“Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God”. That is how you do it: by instructing them. That is the whole armour of God.
